decisions.reason: The requested color confirmations and hover/active states concern the provisioning wizard and do not change the approved landing-page visual design.
The portrait and landscape gaps are wizard-specific placeholders, not a change to the general website responsive-behavior requirement.
Using the existing build approach for a wizard is descriptive context and does not alter the implementation stack or handoff objective.
The candidate's existing message-30 INTRODUCE already records the requested canvas, muted-text, hairline, and Back/Next button-state guidance; no additional or corrected state change is needed.
The source requests styling guidance for the provisioning wizard; references to its canvas surface and buttons do not necessarily change the separate console-shell styling requirement.
Wizard-specific token and interaction-state guidance does not change the established dark visual treatment for follow-on website pages.
The source contains no decision about the website footer or its content.
